test_decisions.scenario: Trusted session-review and neutral-packet steps expose the same GitHub Actions token as GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN without altering permissions or allowing PR-provided refs.
test_decisions.requirement: Issue #157: aliases both available in the trusted reader and negative/registered source regression tests.

search.scope: Existing GitHub Actions review/packet workflow tests and the parent issue reader contract.

candidates.oracle: Require two equivalent aliases in both trusted workflow steps; absent token must remain a hard error and candidate refs must remain rejected.
candidates.comparison: The workflow trust test already existed and was extended in place, rather than creating a new duplicate parser or lowering permissions.

test_decisions.justification: Reuse existing trust-source test module and add precise same-token assertions; no other implementation tests are added.
